Yes, "Jiang" (江) is a very common Chinese surname. It is the 15th most common surname in China and is also widely used in other East Asian countries like Korea and Japan (where it is often romanized as Kang or Ko). The character literally means "river," and many families adopted it as a surname due to their ancestral connection to a specific river or region.
